notes.title: Endless mode update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Ravenous Devils endless mode is now available with this new patch, we suggest you to try this mode once finished the main game.
[b]We also introduce Thai language with this update.[/b]

[b]The goal of the "Endless Mode" is to survive[/b] the policeman inspections and recurring taxes. If you get caught murdering someone or if you don't pay taxes when they occur you will be arrested. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/bea477c9c3b3029766614e7d6254b3543f126c94.gif[/img]

Here you can find out about the new content and challenges.

You can now customize the shops look buying the walls and floors in the "skins" tab, these are available also in the story mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/a49f7adb725483f292d1f976e07697f49ef245e9.gif[/img]

When you kill a client the "Wanted level" will increase

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/67277300f37402fb641daa437ca372a3920e0128.gif[/img]

The more the "Wanted level" increases the more will be the chances that a policeman will come inspect Percival's tailor room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/3495b7a17295630ffe46c5ab613d5b1914d4b765.gif[/img]

You can lower the "Wanted level" by not killing customers. Percival's customers in the tailor room will now generate an order. You can sell them a cloth to get some money and decrease the "Wanted level". If you don't sell them a cloth, when they leave, your "Wanted level" will decrease anyway, but you won't get any money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/c2b2f8190581077c67c3eaa2ec31741be1642de1.gif[/img]

If you don't have meat, because you are not killing customers, you can prepare new recipes that don't involve any kind of meat in the cooking process. Keep in mind that these new recipes are less worth than the meat-based recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/27b604197c2a92b9d8741a34113d2a5dab5f4b8f.png[/img]

There's a new machine that produces flour in the greenhouse, check it out, it's pretty funny :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/b309fea1ed895688c2fd3dd8881441c3f761b970.gif[/img]

[b]Have fun with this new mode![/b]

notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we hope you are having fun serving your customers. 
Here's the first fixes to some problem you reported. More to come in the next days.

Fixed the bug with Hildred where she can use the sink while holding the gin.
Fixed a the bug where 2 clients buy the same cloth, causing an error in the clothes counter.
Now Percival can kill the customer while taking his measurements in the greenhouse tutorial even if you have 5 or more corpses in the kitchen.
Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow the recipe book to be opened after the end of the game. 
Fixed a bug that was deleting trays during tutorials. 
Fixed a bug that would generate another tray, resulting in having 4 trays.

notes.title: Ravenous Devils Demo Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
[h1][b]Ravenous Devils demo is now live. [/b][/h1]
In this demo you will get to play the basic flow of the game and get a taste of the progression and the future events that will happen in the storyline. 
We can't wait to know what do you think about the game and make adjustments based on your feedback in the final release. 
If you can't play this week we are streaming the entire demo on the game page and we'll upload it also on our Youtube channel. In the stream [b]we're also cooking a delicious recipe[/b] :) 
If you want to tell us your opinions there'a a link to a [b]survey[/b] that you find in the [b]game main menu[/b] or you can reach us on our [b]Discord[/b] or even in the [b]game discussions[/b]. 

Make sure your clients in the game are well served and enjoy  your new business!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/07ba923d35aebac3db9853227ff381a500787c66.jpg[/img]
